body: 8-K Item 5.02 filed 12-Nov-2026: board accepted Huang's resignation as President, CEO and board member effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO while a search is conducted; Harvey C. Jones appointed board chair. Agent notes mention an independent board committee investigation — not yet read in the primary text. Verified from primary SEC filing on 21-Nov-2026.
title: NVIDIA: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and director (11-Nov-2026); Colette Kress interim CEO
